topic: Template Class Specialization with Custom Comparator
explanation: In C++, template classes like std::set can accept template parameters that customize their behavior, such as the comparison criterion used for ordering elements. By providing a custom comparator (e.g., std::greater), developers can change the default sorting order or behavior of the container. This feature leverages C++'s template system to create flexible, type-safe, and reusable data structures that adapt to specific requirements at compile time, exemplifying the power of template programming and generic programming idioms in modern C++.
keywords: Custom Comparator, Template Comparator, std::set custom sort, Comparison Criterion
